research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Waabi is researching and developing autonomous driving technology through areas such as learning unsupervised world models for autonomous driving, latent representation based appearance modification for adversarial testing and training, automatic labeling of objects from LiDAR point clouds via trajectory-level refinement, multimodal four-dimensional panoptic segmentation, and validation for autonomous systems. Their work also includes mixed reality simulation, motion forecasting, and trajectory value learning for autonomous systems.

overview_description.description: Waabi develops autonomous driving technology and physical artificial intelligence systems for the transportation sector. The company designs and applies end-to-end AI models and simulation tools to enable self-driving capabilities for trucks and extend these technologies to robotaxis and other automated vehicle platforms. Its offerings include AI-based software for vehicle perception, planning, and control that integrate with partners’ hardware and fleet operations. Waabi collaborates with manufacturers and mobility platforms to integrate its autonomous systems into commercial transport and ride-hailing services. The company also builds large-scale simulation environments to train and validate its vehicle automation technologies.

product.name: Waabi Physical AI Platform
product.description: An autonomous-driving platform that uses a shared end-to-end AI model to support autonomous trucks and robotaxis across different vehicle types, locations, and operating environments.

product.name: Waabi Driver
product.description: An autonomous-driving system combining an end-to-end AI autonomy stack with sensors and onboard computing for integration into commercial vehicles, including autonomous trucks.

product.name: Waabi World
product.description: A neural simulator for developing and validating autonomous-driving systems by reproducing routine conditions, rare edge cases, sensor data, and vehicle interactions in virtual environments.

product.name: Mixed Reality Testing
product.description: A testing service and methodology that combines physical test-track driving with real-time simulated actors, environments, and hazards injected into vehicle sensor data.
